narrative.details:
Floodin' the Thousand Needles is no small feat, adventurer. If I hadn't felt the elements' outrage meself, I'd have never believed it. But here we are.

The quilboar aren't the first tae weaponize the elements irresponsibly, and they won't be the last. If we want to prepare our own counter-ritual, we'll need a better understanding of these twisted elements. Take this book. It details the many denizens of Azeroth and how they practice shamanism.

If you can learn from them, maybe we can find a solution.
narrative.objectives: Collect 5 Twisted Fire Totems, 5 Twisted Earth Totems, 5 Twisted Air Totems, and 5 Twisted Water Totems for Veyric Thunderhame in Arathi Highlands.

chain.subtitle: 5 quests from level 30 to 40, 17,150 XP in all.

quests.name: Storm, Earth, and Fire

quests.name: Heed My Call

quests.name: The Tempest's Weapons
quests.objectiveText: Deliver the Eye of the Tempest to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in Alterac Mountains.
